title: Change some vals entries to equivalent common tfs

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • f0b19dd9 - Change some vals entries to equivalent common tfs
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9281/diffs?diff_id=568269255&start_sha=99e9827ae360131a6323785d49d05e8e17e90220)
it will be no change the display of some field ? (with the bitmap ?)
I did a test and convinced myself it will be the same.  The bits are not shown for FT_BOOLEAN if there is a zero mask.

added 3 commits
  • f0b19dd9...704eaa18 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • dd882801 - Change some vals entries to equivalent common tfs
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9281/diffs?diff_id=568473432&start_sha=f0b19dd9b2a9d044888c2e7e4e4409a92ea17560)

@martin.r.mathieson MBIM dissector was purposely not using TFS as the fields are defined as uint32 in the MBIM spec and not as a single bit field. That's why I would prefer if we reverted this part of the MR.
Thanks Martin (and BTW Happy New Year and best wishes for 2023 :))
